# NFL Daily — 2026-11-14 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson underwent thumb surgery last week; the team's 6-10 week recovery window leaves open a chance he returns later this season. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2121600882496426223)
- The Vikings' trade-deadline call to the Raiders about QB Kirk Cousins went nowhere; Cousins is set to start Sunday at Green Bay. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2121617695795749247)
- A nationwide FAA ground stop forced the NFL to reassign Week 10 officiating crews to games within driving distance of their hometowns. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7781462/2026/11/14/faa-ground-stop-nfl-referees-reassignments-don-willard/)
- The NFL ordered an independent review of how the Eagles handled QB Jalen Hurts' blood clots. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7780403/2026/11/13/jalen-hurts-blood-clots-nfl-nflpa-independent-review/)

- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Vikings QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is out, with the team targeting a Week 12 return. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons (knee/illness) is out for Sunday against the Vikings. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Texans DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring) is out for Sunday against the Browns. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is out for Sunday at Dallas. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs had surgery on a fractured finger and is expected back within a few weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-14 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson underwent thumb surgery last week; the team says recovery typically takes 6 to 10 weeks, leaving open a possible return later this season, though coach Jesse Minter has declined to confirm exactly when the surgery happened. [The Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-lamar-jackson-thumb-surgery-injury-recovery-weeks-QJ45W3R5TNARXJQTB6WW5HHSU4/)
- Coach Jesse Minter says QB Jacoby Brissett has picked up the offense quickly as he takes over while Jackson is out. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/jacoby-brissett-impresses-jesse-minter-ravens-rejuvenated-for-chargers-riley-patterson-strong-practice-week)
- RB Derrick Henry addressed trade rumors that circulated around him at the deadline: "That's in the past... I'm a Raven." [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2121350815046901916)
